headline: MTP4/seqs1 -> MTP3/seqs4 on the same checkpoint and image: identical quality (8/8, all games playable, 0 JS errors), single-stream decode essentially flat (-9%..+2% run-to-run mix, consistent with one fewer draft token), and the real win is off this row's axis: 1->4 concurrent slots so chat, agent tool-calls and memory extraction stop serializing behind each other.
facts: Only: --max-num-seqs 1->4, num_speculative_tokens 4->3. 50-80K tokens each: breakout -9%, delta +2%, fractal -2% vs v033. Short generations (speed/creative/reasoning) carry high sample noise; decode delta sits at the edge of the noise floor.
All 9 tests starved=False, zero retries, ~63 min suite. Delta completed at 81.6K total tokens, inside the 100K window (the rp-era row failed it 3x at the wall).
KV cache at seqs4/MTP3: 138,461 tokens = 1.38x concurrency at 100K. Four max-length streams cannot all sit resident (preemption possible under worst-case 4x-long-context load; not observed).

All 3 games 0 JS errors, painted+responds; breakout/delta also animate (breakout HUD live: score 000050 after input, lives, powerups). Fractal explorer: Mandelbrot+Julia 720x720 + preview, 1000 iters, 628/152 ms renders; animates=False is by design (redraw-on-interaction).

observations.text: MTP3 trades a little single-stream decode (one fewer speculated token per draft) for lower spec-decode overhead - decode deltas here sit at the edge of the noise floor, matching community findings that MTP3 >= MTP4 overall.
Quality untouched, as expected: identical checkpoint + parsers; scores match the v033 row cell-for-cell (8/8, all games playable).

seqs4 is invisible to this single-stream harness by construction - its payoff (chat + agent tool-calls + memory extraction no longer serializing on one slot) is measured in the agent, not the scorecard.

If worst-case 4x100K concurrency is ever needed, raise gpu-mem-util 0.88 -> ~0.93 for ~206K KV (vLLM log suggests 0.8870 already recovers CUDA-graph overhead).
